description.text: Tuition Standards(1) Chinese Government Scholarship students are free of charge.(2) The tuition for self-supporting students is RMB 20,000/school year.Note: the tuition must be paid fully during registration at the beginning of each semester.Deadline of Application: June 30 every yearSchool BeginningThe first Monday of September.

duration.text: The Microbiology Materials at Jiangnan University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passportWith photo, passport number &expiration date and name included.2. Passport-sized photoA passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.3. Bachelor's degree diplomaGraduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.4. Transcript of undergraduate school5.Health certificate Not needed during application. But may required when applying for visa.
